text: Represent project-visible behavior as ordered Behavior Flows containing Actions and Control Steps.
Initial Control Steps include Delay and If/Condition.
Action dispatch use an extensible registry/handler model rather than hard-coded UI branching.
Action definitions contain action type, optional logical target and typed/validated parameters.
Navigation actions include Navigate Page, Next, Previous, Go Back and Go Home.
Popup actions include Open, Close and Close All.
Variable actions include Set, Add, Subtract, Toggle and Reset.
Element/state actions include Show, Hide, Set State and Reset State.
Animation actions include Play, Stop and Restart.
Timeline actions include Start, Pause, Resume, Stop and Restart.
Runtime actions include Reset Screen, Go Initial, Reset Idle Timer, Start Screensaver and Stop Screensaver.
Network actions include Send TCP and Send UDP.
Interaction actions include Lock and Unlock with explicit scope where applicable.
One Trigger may start a Behavior Flow containing multiple Actions.
Trigger families include pointer/touch, keyboard, mouse, network, timeline, media event, variable changed, lifecycle, idle and widget triggers where supported.
External/network events use the same Action Engine as local UI events.
Action handlers fail safely for unavailable/invalid targets and return diagnosable outcomes.
Introduce a second parallel command system for Widgets, network or Player controls.
Asset Library be virtual and independent from physical source folder layout.
AssetRecord retain stable assetId, kind, sourcePath, metadata and optional virtual folder.
Virtual folder rename/move MUST NOT move original source files.
Missing source file preserve AssetRecord and references for relink.
Recognize at least project-supported image, video, audio, font, SVG and animation asset kinds.
Asset import allocate stable IDs and gather usable metadata without making source paths runtime identity.
Project Fonts be explicit project resources.
Build package required Project Fonts and Runtime load them from Build.
System-installed fonts remain usable for compatibility, but portable Project Fonts are preferred.
Import ordinary SVG, including typical Figma-exported SVG, without requiring semantic naming conventions.
Parse supported groups/primitives/text/images/geometry/transforms/fill/stroke/opacity/clip-mask information.
Map SVG groups to Containers where appropriate.
Register/materialize external SVG-linked assets through Asset Library.
Unsupported SVG constructs fail visibly or preserve fidelity as practical; MUST NOT silently disappear without diagnostic.
Capture an immutable ProjectDocument snapshot at Build start.
Run full structural, referential, semantic and resource validation against that snapshot before compilation.
Abort Build on any Error-severity Problem and leave the previous published Build untouched.
Discover runtime dependencies transitively from Screens, Pages, Elements, Widgets, Components, Playlists, fonts, system visuals and other compiled runtime entities.
Include only assets reachable from the runtime dependency graph; unused registered assets MUST NOT be required for Build success.
A missing source asset reachable from the runtime dependency graph is a Build Error.
Treat a missing unused registered asset as a Build-blocking error.
Compile authoring ProjectDocument into a separate RuntimeProject representation.
Copy authoring-only metadata such as Designer Canvas frame positions into RuntimeProject unless explicitly required at runtime.
Replace authoring asset source paths with Build-relative packaged asset paths.
Preserve stable assetId as runtime identity.
Materialize project fonts required by runtime into Build; Player MUST NOT depend on fonts being installed in Windows.
Compile Component instances from their pinned revisions and applied overrides; historical unused revisions need not ship to Player.
Ask each Widget Contract for declared asset dependencies.
Produce `project.json`.
Produce `manifest.json` containing buildId, projectId, runtimeFormatVersion, createdAt and packaged asset entries with assetId/path/kind/size/hash.
Verify packaged output before publication.
Publish atomically so a failed/incomplete Build never replaces a valid prior Build.
Include Screen→Display mapping or Multi-PC topology in project.json.
Require automatic media transcoding in initial V2.
Build progress/errors be observable to Constructor UI.
Player validate critical RuntimeProject/runtime dependencies when loading a Build and refuse invalid critical definitions safely.
Runtime missing/corrupt packaged content after deployment degrade locally where possible rather than corrupting runtime state.
Collect Project and Build remain distinct operations: Collect copies all registered assets for portable authoring; Build packages only runtime dependencies.
Component Definition store revision history with one current revision.
Component Instance reference componentId and pinned revisionId.
Saving edited Component Definition create a new revision.
Existing instances remain on prior revision until explicit Review & Apply.
Review identify affected instances and conflicts.
Instance overrides remain authoritative by default on conflict.
Detach materialize instance as independent local Elements and remove future component-update linkage.
Nested Components be supported unless dependency cycle validation rejects a cycle.
Widget be a functional module with internal state/behavior and a declared customization contract.
Widget need not expose all internals as ordinary Elements.
Initial architecture support Gallery, Image Viewer, Quiz, Form and Mini-game widget families.
Gallery contract support content/order, viewport, previous/next, pagination, loop and transition configuration.
Image Viewer contract support image, viewport, zoom range, pan and reset.
Quiz contract support questions/answers and visual states including Normal/Selected/Correct/Incorrect/results.
Mini-game may use Canvas/WebGL internally while remaining compliant with Widget lifecycle/actions/triggers/build dependencies.
Initial V2 expose a public third-party Widget SDK requirement.
Constructor edit ProjectDocument only through controlled Project Operations rather than arbitrary UI mutation.
Keep Editor UI state separate from ProjectDocument.
Support undoable reversible Project Operations for ordinary editing.
Support multiple Screens, each with fixed pixel width/height and independent Page set.
Provide infinite Designer Canvas workspace for arranging Page/Popup/Screensaver/system frames without affecting runtime coordinates.
Page dimensions equal owning Screen resolution.
Provide Canvas pan, zoom, fit, lock, grid rows/columns and snap-to-grid.
Support create/select/move/8-direction resize/delete/copy/paste/duplicate of applicable Elements.
Expose X/Y/W/H and relevant visual properties for Elements.
Support ordinary Text, Image, Button, Video, Container and Widget/Component instance elements required by the model.
Support virtual Asset Library folders without moving original source files.
Drag/drop/import assets while assigning stable asset IDs.
Missing source assets preserve registry IDs/references and allow relink.
Collect Project copy all registered assets without moving originals and produce a portable editable project.
Full Preview run same Runtime Engine semantics as Player.
Preview support Physical Displays mode and All Screens Simulator mode.
Preview snapshot project state; editing after preview start MUST NOT silently hot-mutate the active runtime session.
Problems panel expose validation Problems and support navigation to affected authoring entity where feasible.
Content Admin be a Constructor mode governed by explicit exposure allow-list.
Initial Content Admin arbitrarily create/delete project structure unless later explicitly added.
Content Admin edits modify the working project and require new Build/deployment to affect Player.
SVG import parse ordinary exported SVG structure and materialize required external assets into project assets.
Project fonts be manageable as project resources and packaged by Build.
Component editing create a new revision rather than silently mutating all existing instances.
Provide controlled Review & Apply Updates flow for component instances and preserve overrides by default.
Treat `ProjectDocument` as the sole editable project source of truth.
Persist Editor UI state or Runtime state into `ProjectDocument` unless a future explicit requirement adds such persistence.
Use stable opaque IDs for independently referenceable entities; display names are not identity.
Save `.iss` atomically using temporary output, validation and replacement.
Perform explicit sequential forward migrations; older apps MUST refuse unsupported newer formats safely.
Route project-visible events through Trigger → Behavior Flow → Action Engine.
Process accepted events in observed arrival order without a global busy lock.
A Delay pauses only its owning Behavior Flow.
Page Leave cancels Page-owned flows/delays/timelines/media/animations, closes Page popups and destroys Page-local state.
Page Leave reset Screen or Shared Variables.
Ignore stale asynchronous completion from invalidated Page/media/runtime generations.
Reset Screen creates a clean initial Screen state and invalidates pending work owned by the previous Screen session.
Provide exactly one system fullscreen Screen Media Player per Screen.
Keep Page media Elements separate from the system Screen Media Player.
Page background video/media support autoplay, loop, volume, mute/unmute and audible playback.
Implement a separate V2 Screenless runtime mode.
A new Play Content request supersedes stale pending preparation for older requested content on the same Screen Media Player.
Media Timeline follow actual media playback time and pause with media playback.
Runtime behavior targets logical Screen IDs, never physical Display IDs.
Store Screen→Display mapping in PlayerLocalConfig, not ProjectDocument or Build.
Never silently remap a missing physical display.
Failure/unavailability of one Screen output MUST NOT intentionally stop healthy Screens.
Player consumes Build only and MUST NOT open `.iss`.
Build operate from a ProjectDocument snapshot.
Full validation occur before publish; required used missing assets are Build Errors.
Package only runtime-required asset dependencies.
Publish Build atomically and preserve the previous valid Build on failure.
Generate runtime `project.json` and `manifest.json`; authoring source paths MUST NOT be runtime dependencies.
Every Widget declare stable `widgetType` and `widgetSchemaVersion`.
Widget project-visible behavior integrate through registered Actions/Triggers.
Widget asset dependencies be discoverable by Build.
Dispose/cancel Widget-owned work on Page Leave.
Permit project-authored arbitrary executable JavaScript as Widget props.
Component instances remain pinned to a revision until controlled update is applied.
Instance overrides win by default during component update review.
Silently propagate component changes over existing instance overrides.
Treat incoming TCP/UDP as Trigger sources and outgoing messages as Actions.
Unknown/unmatched network input fail safely and be diagnosable.
Treat Multi-PC topology as deployment-local installation configuration.
Add a per-Action `synchronized` authoring checkbox as the synchronization model.
Synchronized distributed operations support preparation/readiness and a common future execution time when preparation/timing is required.
A disconnected Client after installation startup MUST NOT freeze unrelated healthy nodes indefinitely.
Each Screen have at most one Screensaver system entity.
Screensaver support simple background/image/video/text/logo/animation visual composition.
Page define its idle timeout/behavior.
Relevant processed user/runtime activity reset idle timer according to runtime policy; raw unmatched network noise MUST NOT count as meaningful activity.
Screensaver capture user input while visible.
User input may hide Screensaver when configured; external Trigger MUST NOT automatically hide it unless behavior says so.
Entering Screensaver close active Page Popups and Screen Media Player as defined by canonical lifecycle while keeping underlying Page runtime alive.
Provide configurable Screen Error/Fallback Visual plus built-in neutral fallback.
Error Visual support simple media/text and optional short error code.
Missing single content asset degrade locally where practical instead of forcing whole Screen Error state.
Critical inability to render a Screen enter Screen Error state and show Error Visual.
Visitor-facing error UI MUST NOT expose raw stack traces.
Developer diagnostics expose current Screen/Page/runtime status.
Diagnostics expose loaded RuntimeProject/project data in developer UI.
Diagnostics expose network command log and manual send.
Developer Preview expose Event/Action trace, variables, timelines and media/playlist state.
Diagnostic failure MUST NOT alter project layout semantics.
`Play Content` accept either a single Asset or first-class Playlist as content source.
Playlist preserve explicit item order independent of filesystem order.
Quick Import Folder may create a Playlist, but later filesystem changes MUST NOT silently redefine Playlist membership/order.
Image playlist items support duration; Video items use natural duration unless range overrides apply.
Video playlist items support volume, mute and playback range settings.
Non-loop Playlist finish exit content after final item.
Next/Previous at a non-loop boundary exit content according to approved V1-equivalent behavior.
Looping Playlist cycle deterministically.
Emit Started, Item Started, Item Finished and Finished media/playlist events where applicable.
Screen Media Player support Play, Pause, Stop, Restart, Seek, Next/Previous Item, Volume and Mute/Unmute actions.
Replacing currently playing content leave only the newest accepted content active.
Old preparation completion MUST NOT steal playback after a newer content request.
Page navigation while Screen Media Player is active close/stop it using Media Exit semantics before/with Page transition as defined by runtime composition.
Natural content finish/Stop/Exit reveal the underlying current Page unless configured behavior navigates elsewhere.
Page background media be Page-owned and stop/dispose on Page Leave.
Page background video/media support audible playback, autoplay, loop, volume and mute/unmute.
Media Timeline clock derive from actual source media time.
Media Timeline pause with media and follow Seek.
Media Timeline events crossed during configured loop playback be able to fire on each playback pass.
Decoder/timeupdate jitter MUST NOT create unintended duplicate bursts of the same timeline event.
Initial V2 use simple on-demand/targeted preparation rather than a global predictive cache.
Screen Media Player prepare requested media before playback.
Playlist prepare current + next item where cheap/useful.
Preparation be invalidatable on replacement/reset/lifecycle termination.
Central Player Network Service own configured TCP/UDP listeners.
Support multiple listening ports.
Network Trigger support Any/specific source IP and optional source-port filtering.
Initial payload matching support Exact, Starts With and Contains.
Require Regex matching in initial V2.
TCP listener support configurable framing with newline default and advanced fixed/raw modes.
UDP treat datagram payload as message without TCP framing.
One Network Trigger may execute multiple Actions including cross-Screen actions.
Support named outgoing Network Endpoints with transport/host/port/framing data.
Preview use real TCP/UDP behavior, not a fake simulation layer.
Network Monitor record timestamp, direction, source/destination, payload, matched trigger, resulting actions and outcome/unmatched status.
Developer tools allow manual outgoing network command for diagnostics.
Multi-PC installation support Master/Server and Client node roles.
Node identity use a stable nodeId; IP may be used as address/security restriction but MUST NOT be the sole conceptual identity.
Client maintain/re-establish long-lived connection to Master and re-synchronize clock after reconnect.
Master track expected Clients and readiness.
Initial installation startup support strict waiting for Required Clients before ready state.
Architecture support Required/Optional node classification; default expected nodes may be Required.
Distributed operations needing prepared resources use PREPARE → READY barrier → future timestamped EXECUTE/START.
Clients convert Master execution time using established clock offset.
Playlist/sequence advancement in synchronized playback repeat synchronization for the next item rather than only synchronizing initial playback.
After installation is running, loss of one Client MUST NOT globally stop healthy nodes.
Actions targeted to unavailable node fail safely and appear in diagnostics.
Reconnected Client join future synchronized operations after clock sync; missed historical actions MUST NOT be automatically replayed.
Transparently synchronize ordinary Shared Player Variables across PCs in initial V2.
`.iss` contain authoring model and stable projectId plus independent formatVersion.
formatVersion change only for persistent schema compatibility changes, not every app release.
Migration run forward sequentially in memory before normal editing.
Original project file remain untouched until explicit Save.
First Save after migration create migration backup before replacing original.
Unsupported newer format fail safely without destructive rewrite.
Unsaved work recovery use a separate debounced recovery snapshot keyed by projectId.
Recovery snapshot MUST NOT replace normal `.iss` save semantics.
After abnormal restart, Constructor offer Recover/Discard when valid recovery exists.
Normal close with dirty project support Save / Don't Save / Cancel; Don't Save removes stale recovery for that session.
Copy/Duplicate/Import discover owned graph, allocate new IDs, rewrite internal references, preserve external dependencies and commit atomically as one Project Operation.
On first launch with no configured project, show technician setup allowing Build selection.
Validate selected Build before entering normal runtime.
On normal configured startup, avoid visitor-facing technical setup UI; show neutral/black startup surface until runtime is ready.
Persist selected Build path/project identity, display mapping, startup/dev settings and Multi-PC node configuration in PlayerLocalConfig outside installed application files.
Preserve PlayerLocalConfig through normal manual application reinstall/update.
Detect physical Windows displays and expose resolution/position/scale/primary metadata needed for mapping.
Allow max one logical Screen per physical Display and max one Display per logical Screen.
Display Mapping changes be staged until Save.
Applying saved mapping dynamically create/retain/close/reassign runtime windows where possible without mandatory whole-Player restart.
Missing assigned physical Display leave other Screens running and MUST NOT silently remap.
Provide Identify Displays and Rescan Displays technician functions.
Open global Developer Mode via Ctrl+Shift+D using physical key/code semantics independent of keyboard layout.
Developer tools include Load/choose Build, Clear Project, Display Mapping, Network diagnostics and runtime diagnostics.
Clear Project stop runtime and return to no-project/setup state.
Dev overlay appear as top system layer without changing project viewport/layout geometry.
Production Player not use ESC as a default visitor exit mechanism.
One renderer crash be recoverable by Main recreating only that Screen window/session where possible.
Whole-Player crash be recoverable by external watchdog restart into configured Build with clean runtime session.
Produce human-readable rotating diagnostic logs with Screen/project/runtime context.
Constructor Preview use the same Runtime Engine source/packages as Player.
Preview compile a project snapshot through Runtime Compiler semantics before starting RuntimeSession.
Preview execute real Actions, media, timelines, Widgets and TCP/UDP semantics.
All Screens Simulator create real logical ScreenRuntimeSessions rendered scaled for inspection; scaling MUST NOT change logical project resolution.
Physical Displays preview use explicit local mapping and MUST NOT write deployment mapping into ProjectDocument.
Developer overlay be outside project visual coordinate system.
ESC may exit Developer Preview but production Player MUST NOT inherit this as default kiosk exit.
Preview restart from a new snapshot rather than live-mutating active Runtime definition.
Create one independent ScreenRuntimeSession per active logical Screen.
Maintain exactly one active PageRuntime per normal ScreenRuntimeSession.
Page Enter create fresh Page-local runtime state.
Page Enter fire lifecycle behavior and start eligible auto Page Timeline at 00:00.
Page Leave close Page-owned Popups.
Page Leave cancel Page-owned Behavior Flows and Delays.
Page Leave stop Page Timeline and Page-owned media/animations.
Page Leave destroy Page-local state.
Re-entering a Page create a fresh Page runtime.
`oncePerScreenSession` timeline flags survive Page re-entry and reset on Reset Screen/clean restart.
Navigation during an in-progress transition avoid duplicate Page runtimes/orphan transitions; the later accepted destination determines final state.
Screen Variables survive Page navigation and reset on Reset Screen.
Shared Player Variables survive Page navigation and ordinary single-Screen reset unless explicitly targeted.
Variable Changed emit only according to defined value-change semantics, not merely because a Set action was attempted.
Interaction Lock block configured user-input scope while allowing system/external events by default.
Timelines/media continue while Interaction Lock is active unless explicitly stopped.
Reset Screen close media/popups, cancel owned work, reset Screen variables/once flags/idle/nav history/locks and enter initial Page.
Screensaver show/hide MUST NOT fire Page Leave/Enter.
Underlying Page Timeline continue beneath Screensaver and Screen Media Player unless explicitly paused/stopped.
Popup runtime cannot outlive its owning Page.
Opening the same Popup repeatedly MUST NOT create uncontrolled duplicates unless the Popup contract explicitly allows multiple instances.
A stale async callback carry/validate owner generation identity before mutating runtime.
A recoverable Widget/content error be contained to the smallest practical runtime boundary.
Renderer recreation start the affected Screen from a clean initial Screen state; exact crash-time state restoration is not required.
Other healthy ScreenRuntimeSessions continue when one Screen renderer fails.
Project support multiple logical Screens.
Screen have stable ID, name, fixed width/height, Pages and one initialPageId.
Screen width/height define orientation/aspect; no separate mandatory orientation flag is required.
Every normal V2 Screen use the Page model; no Screenless special runtime path.
Page dimensions equal owning Screen resolution.
Page support navigation and scroll flow modes.
Long content be expressible with Scrollable Containers and/or sequential scroll composition without changing Screen resolution.
Page own ordinary Elements, Popups, optional Page Timeline, idle settings and Page lifecycle behaviors.
Screen persistent layer survive Page changes with per-Page visibility control.
Independently editable Elements have stable IDs and transforms including x/y/width/height/rotation/scale.
Elements support visibility, opacity, z-order and locking where applicable.
Container is a real parent owning child element IDs; ownership graph MUST be acyclic.
Base primitives include Text, Image, Button, Video and Container.
Button support text/visual styling/icon and Behavior bindings.
Text support font family, size, color and horizontal/vertical alignment.
Image/video support fit/crop behavior appropriate to media type.
Element references to project assets use assetId, not source filesystem path.
Layering and arbitrary positioning reproduce reference-case compositions.
Use one Project Validation Engine across Open, Save, Build, Collect and manual validation contexts.
Represent findings as structured Problems with severity Error/Warning/Info and target/context data.
Separate structural/schema, referential/semantic and resource/build validation concerns.
Error block Build; Warning and Info do not.
Validation report problems without silently modifying project data.
Run fast/debounced validation after relevant edits and full validation for Open/manual/Collect/Build as appropriate.
Detect broken entity references and invalid ownership/cycles where the data model forbids them.
Detect missing runtime-required assets during full Build validation.
Validate Widget props/dependencies through Widget Contract.
Validate Component dependency cycles and pinned revision references.
Validate Screen initialPageId and other required runtime entry points.
Quick Fix, if added, remain explicit user action and MUST NOT be a prerequisite for validation correctness.
